purpose: Targeted generic-only A/B for Order 107 hypothesis 1 after preserving and auditing the untouched v94 baseline failure.
change_scope: One generic model-context change: batch PDF and OCR text results use a hard 64000-character JSON budget, fairly distribute encoded text across at most 20 returned files, preserve complete short files when the budget permits, and give a truthful narrow-pattern/page-range recovery instruction when content is shortened.

implementation_evidence.parent_diagnosis: The untouched v94 baseline extracted 41553 characters from nine PDFs and read the target workbook, but its model-visible batch context retained only roughly 160 leading characters per PDF. Qwen retried with max_chars_per_file=20000, received the same short context, then entered failed extraction and catalog-search loops until the eight-event no-progress window stopped it after 222.862 Agent seconds. Evaluator reward was 0.0 and the strict audit was valid.
implementation_evidence.counterfactual_scope: Four unrelated 3000-character paper fixtures prove complete short files remain visible. Thirteen structurally different 12000-character report fixtures prove encoded text is distributed fairly, every file remains represented, truncation is explicit, and the complete JSON stays within 64000 characters.
implementation_evidence.model_choice_contract: The context builder uses only the selected Adapter response. It does not read task identity, instruction text, evaluator state, golden data, filenames beyond displaying returned paths, or answer values; it neither selects an action nor changes model arguments.
implementation_evidence.instruction_top_k: unchanged public action selection and Top-K; no action or schema was added
implementation_evidence.ruff: all active integrations, scripts, and unit tests passed lint; changed files passed format checks
implementation_evidence.project_layout: passed, including generic deployment leakage scan and canonical links
implementation_evidence.osworld_evaluator_tree: frozen commit with zero tracked evaluator/test changes; unrelated untracked .conda environment retained

protocol.dynamic_instruction_schema_or_stage_forc: conditional generic code-execution guidance only; no schema, action, or argument forcing
protocol.on_failure: Preserve and audit this hypothesis-1 A/B, classify the new failure, and do not rerun it unchanged. At most two additional materially different generic hypotheses remain before marking Order 107 task_blocked and advancing.

selection.method: targeted A/B for the current first non-pass ledger task
